Want to Look Around Before You Arrive?

Walking into an Orthodox church for the first time can be a little overwhelming — there is a lot to see, hear, and take in. This wonderful video series with Frederica Mathewes-Green offers a friendly introduction to Orthodox worship and explains many of the things you'll encounter when you visit.

You don't need to watch any of these before coming. But if you're curious — or simply feel more comfortable knowing what to expect — they're a wonderful place to start.

An Introduction to the Orthodox Worship Space

An Overview of the Orthodox Divine Liturgy

The Sign of the Cross, Icons, and Tradition in the Orthodox Church

A Little More About the Orthodox Worship Space

Watch the full series

None of this is homework. You do not need to understand Orthodoxy before you come. Come and see.
